string.text: Graphics are set for this device. Quality shows the best picture it keeps at 60 frames per second; Performance keeps a safety margin, and runs at 120 where the display does.
Quality: the best picture the device keeps at 60 frames per second. Performance: lower render resolution for a steadier frame rate, or 120 frames per second on a 120 Hz display.
Limits the frame rate. Auto uses the mode's rate: 60, or 120 in Performance mode on a 120 Hz display.
Size of the text in menus and on the HUD. The text follows the screen's height by itself; this makes it larger or smaller still. Applies when the video restarts.
